surface_name: Bolt on AWS Lambda and other FaaS
title: Slack command shows operation_timeout or the work never finishes on Lambda or Cloud Functions
symptoms: ack() runs but the follow-up message is never posted
Works locally, fails only after deploy to a function runtime
cause: Bolt acknowledges first and keeps working afterwards, but function runtimes freeze or stop once the HTTP response is sent. Without process_before_response the rest of the listener never runs, and with it the whole listener must still finish within three seconds.
fix: Set processBeforeResponse in Bolt JS (or use AwsLambdaReceiver), and in Bolt Python set process_before_response=True and move slow work into lazy listeners.
apply:
app = App(process_before_response=True)
app.command("/report")(ack=lambda ack: ack(), lazy=[build_and_post_report])
affected: Bolt for JavaScript and Bolt for Python on AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions and similar runtimes, as of 2026-10
